rationale: Revision addresses critical and low-severity findings. (1) Target leakage: removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set—these post-adjudication fields are unavailable at claim submission time and directly correlated with paid_amount > 95th percentile, artificially inflating model performance. Retained only submission-time features: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present. (2) The implausibly high ROC-AUC (>0.99) resulted from leakage; removing these fields normalizes metrics. (3) Missing synthetic_data caveat: added to write_report caveats. Retrieved denial-rate skill does not apply to cost-prediction modeling; no skills listed.
changes_summary: Removed billed_amount and allowed_amount from feature_set to eliminate target leakage; added synthetic_data to write_report caveats for transparency. These changes resolve the critical statistical-discipline finding and the low-severity communication finding; the correctness issue (ROC-AUC) will resolve once leakage is eliminated.
